content.text:
I read the transcript and matched each key item to the record.

**Pairings and checks**

| Key | Record | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| e1 contract | 1 | $1.2M / 3 years correct; misses the ~$180k first milestone and calls Nov 2026 the "start" rather than the first milestone |
| e2 hire | 0 | Feb 2027 project engineer at $95–100k is absent |
| e3 Owen/college | 0 | absent |
| a1 solo 401(k) open + fund | 2 | captures the open; no dollar figures at all ($24,500 / $33,000 / $57,500, Oct 30 payroll start, Q1-2027 employer deposit all missing) — no wrong figure carried |
| a2 $200k to money fund | 3 | $200,000 is the corrected final figure (down from the proposed $250k) — correct |
| a3 discontinue SEP | 0 | only appears folded into record 2, which is already spent on a1; no separate item, and the Pellrose letter / participant notice / "account stays open" detail is absent |
| i1 e-sign package | 7 | owner Devin correct; **due is wrong — Tuesday the 22nd (2026-09-22), record says 2026-10-22**; also omits the SEP discontinuance letter, notice and corporate resolution |
| i2 key-person quotes | 6 | Devin / 2026-10-01 correct; omits $1M and $1.5M, 10- and 15-year, company-owned, 101(j) — but carries no wrong figure |
| i3 CPA meeting | 5 | Marisol (correctly reassigned from Anneliese) / 2026-10-06 correct. Names the CPA "Pelletier," the spelling the meeting expressly corrected to **Peltier** at [00:11:30]; not a figure/owner/date, so flagged in the note only. Missing the $132,000 and $33,000 confirmations and the Oct 30 deferral start |
| i4 pension estimate | 4 | Graham / 2026-10-09 correct (the moved date, not the abandoned 25th); age 61 correct |
| i5 rerun projection | 0 | absent |
| i6 send LOC agreement | 0 | absent |
| i7 read LOC agreement | 0 | absent |

**NOT ACTIONS** — none of the four (SEP rollover, cash balance plan, business overhead expense policy, T-bill ladder) appear in the record. Clean on that dimension.

**Extras** — none; every record item pairs to a key item.

**Bottom line:** 7 of 13 key items captured. The record misses both remaining life events and four action items, including the whole line-of-credit/insurance-contingency thread. Only one hard error in what it does record — the e-signature due date is a month late — but the near-total absence of figures ($180k, $95–100k, $24,500, $33,000, $57,500, $132,000, $1M/$1.5M) means the captured items are thin rather than wrong.

key_items.note: $1.2 million total over three years matches. Omits the ~$180,000 first milestone and frames November 2026 as the contract 'starting' rather than the first milestone billing; no incorrect figure is carried, so figures pass.
No record item mentions the first full-time W-2 hire, a project engineer around February 2027 at $95,000-$100,000.
No record item mentions Owen, the two early action applications due November 1, or college starting fall 2027.

Record item 2 captures opening the solo 401(k) sponsored by Tendry Acoustic Design, Inc. Amount is NOT_FOUND, so it carries no wrong figure, but it omits the $24,500 pre-tax deferral across the Oct 30/Nov/Dec payrolls, the $33,000 employer profit-sharing on the corrected $132,000 W-2, the $57,500 2026 total, the Pellrose custodian and the pre-March-2027 funding deadline.

$200,000 is the final figure Marisol negotiated down from Anneliese's proposed $250,000; government money market fund in a new business brokerage account is correct. Does not name Marrowgate or Pellrose, or the authorization on the account application, but nothing is wrong.

SEP discontinuance appears only as a clause inside record item 2, which is already paired to a1; one record item cannot capture two key items. There is no standalone item, and the letter to Pellrose, the written participant notice, and the fact that the SEP IRA stays open with no money moving are all absent.

Owner Devin Oakes is right. Due date is wrong: Devin committed to Tuesday the 22nd (2026-09-22) at [00:15:02] and Anneliese confirmed it in the recap; the record says 2026-10-22, a month late. Also omits the SEP discontinuance letter, the participant notice and the corporate resolution from the package.

Devin Oakes and Thursday, October 1 (2026-10-01) both match. Carries no figures, so figures pass, but it omits the $1,000,000 and $1,500,000 amounts, the 10- and 15-year level term structure, company-owned/company-beneficiary, and the section 101(j) notice-and-consent form.

Owner correctly reflects the reassignment from Anneliese to Marisol at [00:24:41]-[00:25:26], and 2026-10-06 matches. The CPA is written 'Jonas Pelletier'; the meeting explicitly corrected this to Peltier at [00:11:30] ('P-E-L-T-I-E-R. Everybody adds the extra le'). That is a name rather than a figure, owner or date, so it does not flip a flag, but it is an error the transcript expressly fixed. Also omits confirming the $132,000 W-2 and $33,000 employer contribution and the October 30 payroll deferral start.

Graham Tendry and 2026-10-09 are the final versions; correctly uses the moved date rather than the abandoned Friday the 25th. Age 61 matches. Omits that the estimate is requested through the state system member portal and sent to Anneliese.
No record item covers Anneliese rerunning the projection with Marisol at 58, Graham at 61 and $57,500 into the solo 401(k), ready before the December 8 meeting.
No record item covers Marisol sending the Marrowgate line of credit agreement to Devin by Monday the 21st.
No record item covers Devin reading the line of credit agreement for life insurance, collateral assignment or covenant requirements before the October 1 quotes return.
